guarantees: Stable deterministic phase ordering independent of registration order.
Authoritative systems are never skippable; only visual/presentation work may be dropped.
Each state namespace has one declared owner.
State updates are atomic and stale writes are rejected.
Player, AI, campaign, and world actions use the same auditable proposal gate.
Derived metrics preserve evidence and algorithm lineage.
Independent branch manifests must assemble without missing contracts.
A build cannot be called first-map ready while a required check is failed or not run.
Commands commit module state and event batches atomically.
Snapshots restore explicitly and experiments fork with branch lineage.
Contribution attribution cannot exceed 100% of one causal value occurrence.
Animation signals are rebuildable and non-authoritative.
Counterfactual plans are read-only and never auto-commit.
Recovered visitors retain prior exposure and cannot silently become first-time again.
Runtime numeric boundaries reject NaN, infinity, negative population, and malformed hashes before state commit.
Animation and contribution identities are stable across serialization and insertion order.
